## Summary

<!-- What and why. Link issues with Fixes #nnn when applicable. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new capability (minor)
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix (patch)
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `chore` / `ci` / `test`
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!` / `BREAKING CHANGE:` in the commit)

## How to verify

<!-- Commands you ran, e.g. bun run test, make up, bun run lint -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title (used by semantic-release on `main`)
- [ ] `bun run lint` and `bun run typecheck` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated when behavior changed (`bun run test` / `make test`)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, or production credentials in the diff
- [ ] Handler keys / queue names / API paths match the code (no drive-by renames)
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
